SPECIAL SURVEILLANCE REPORT - CASE-A-001
DATE: 11/03/2026
LOCATION: Plot 12, Phase 1, Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi 110020

Surveillance log by Sub-Inspector K. Rathore.
At 21:30 IST on 11/03/2026, suspect vehicle DL01AB1234 was spotted parked outside Plot 12, Phase 1, Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi 110020.
A male individual identified as Arjun Verma, age 28, S/o Suresh Verma, was observed meeting Vikram Singh alias Vicky.
Arjun Verma handed over a package to Vikram Singh.
Vikram Singh was operating mobile number +919876543210 during the meeting.
Suspects departed towards Ashram Chowk in vehicle DL01AB1234.

SYNTHETIC TEST DATA - FOR DEMO ONLY
